literal: Unangry petty words and the look like angry ones, acting like unattached ones, are the attached ones' sign.
translation: Feigned harsh words spoken without real anger and looks that mimic an enemy are the secret signs of lovers who pretend to be strangers.
modern: உண்மையில் கோபம் இல்லாமல் சொல்லப்படும் சிறுமையான சொற்களும், பகைவர்களைப் போலப் பார்க்கும் பார்வையும், தமக்குள் எந்த உறவும் இல்லாதவர்கள் போல நடிக்கும் காதலர்களின் குறிப்புகளாகும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the secret communication between lovers when they are in public. Though they pretend to be strangers who have no connection, their true attachment is revealed through their behavior. They may speak petty, harsh words and cast angry glances, but these are done without any real anger. These feigned negative interactions are actually intimate signs of their deep mutual affection.
